verdicts.reason: A keeps the original reading order (FAMILY DAYS OUT IN → London → tagline) in one left-hand stack, but the background photo is badly upscaled and blurry. The translucent panel is gone, so the dark text sits straight on a busy city image, and the chevrons are scattered: one set jams against 'London' and the other floats alone at the far right. The middle and right of the banner are dead photo. B breaks the hierarchy: 'London' sits above its own lead-in 'FAMILY DAYS OUT IN', which shrinks to tiny text in the middle. The chevrons pile into one oversized, overlapping arrow cluster along the bottom edge. The tagline is tiny and stranded at the right on a busy background, so all the text is scattered with no shared alignment.
